item.title: Policy and Procedure Templates
item.description:
The forms here are outlines that add items specific to the financial sector. For general open source policy and process forms, use the existing policy and procedure templates guide, and use the forms below for what the financial sector additionally needs: import control, risk assessment for network separation exceptions, and SBOM requirements for outsourcing.

How to use

The outlines below are not finished documents to use as they are, but frames to fill in. Replace the parts in square brackets to suit your organization. Have them reviewed by your internal legal and security teams before issuing them.

item.title: Artifacts: Ready-to-Use Forms and Recipes
item.description:
This guide provides four ready-to-use artifacts along with the main text. Where the main text explains “what to do and why,” the artifacts fill in “in what form to record it.” Each artifact is meant to be adapted to your organization’s situation.

Artifact Use
Self-Check Workbook Combines check items, ISO verification materials, and compliance status, owner, and deadline in a single sheet to find the gaps in your program
Policy and Procedure Templates Provides outlines for a finance-specific policy, an import procedure, a usage approval form, and a self risk assessment report for network separation exceptions
Audit Evidence List Organizes, as a checklist, the evidence required in internal and external audits and supervisory inspections and where it is kept
Tool Setup Recipe Provides an example of setting up and integrating on-premises SBOM and vulnerability tools in a closed network with docker-compose
How to use

The artifacts supplement the existing policy and procedure templates guide for the financial context. Use the existing templates for general practice forms, and use these artifacts together with them for items specific to the financial sector (import control, risk assessment for network separation exceptions, and SBOM requirements for outsourcing).
